visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with reddish-brown hair, wearing glasses and a black hoodie with the 'aide garage' logo, stands in front of a sleek black car on a bright sunny day. He gestures with his hands, pointing at the camera and then toward himself, while speaking with animated facial expressions under a high concrete overpass. (2) The scene shifts to include a second man wearing a grey long-sleeved shirt standing next to the first man. They are positioned beside the same black car, which shows visible damage to the side-view mirror. The first man places a hand on the second man's shoulder in a consoling manner. (3) A dashcam footage insert appears, showing a white ISUZU truck colliding with the side of a parked vehicle on a city street during the day. Green road signs and traffic lights are visible in the background as the truck scrapes against the side. (4) Back to the two men outdoors, the man in the hoodie continues to talk while the man in the grey shirt looks down sadly. The lighting is bright and natural, highlighting the textures of their clothing and the reflective surface of the black car's paint. (5) The camera cuts to a close-up of a white car with its front end completely crushed and overgrown with tall grass. This car is severely damaged, with the hood crumpled upward and the engine bay exposed. The man in the hoodie points at it for comparison. (6) Returning to the black car, the man in the hoodie squats down to examine the driver-side door. He uses his knuckles to rap on the metal panel, demonstrating its sound. The camera provides a close-up of the dented door and the shattered glass of the side-view mirror hanging by wires. (7) The two men stand together again, laughing and talking. The man in the hoodie holds the broken mirror housing as he explains something. The background remains consistent with the urban street, featuring parked cars and industrial structures in the distance.
